name: wt.ai-desktop
description: wt.ai desktop app for macOS and Windows

scripts.dev: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.dist: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --win
